Digest.description:
A content digest, lowercase hex. The algorithm is the fingerprint module's
choice; the model only fixes the form.

ProjectId.description: Identifies a project: one Git repository Nodal manages units for.

ProjectName.description: A project's display name, taken from its directory or its remote.

Timestamp.description: A UTC instant, serialised as an RFC 3339 string.

description: A repository Nodal knows about, and the recipe it was last read with.

created_at.description: When Nodal first saw this project.

name.description: Display name; the handle a user sees in `nodal ls`.

recipe_hash.description:
Digest of the effective recipe, so a changed `nodal.toml` is visible without
re-reading the file.

root.description: Absolute path of the repository root on this host.

title: Project
